reason: A local fermented Koso made from upcycled Réunion fruit is exactly the kind of story I can build a seasonal signature cocktail around and post on Instagram. I'd ask for the free sample first, and if it tastes right I'd order one litre to test on the new menu. I won't switch my everyday syrups.
objection: It's fermented, so how long does it keep once opened and does it have to live in the fridge? I don't have much fridge space behind the bar, and at 23 euros a litre, two or three times what I pay my distributor, I can't have half a bottle turning on me.
